integrity: The infinite-family statement is proved analytically from the Pauli-tetrahedron representation and partial-transpose parity action; finite matrix checks are supplementary and are not used as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the four-vertex BCABE/generalized-Smolin simplex.
PPT on an even-size cut is not claimed to imply separability except where established separately in the cited literature.
Negativity is not identified with distillable entanglement.
title: Parity law for partial-transpose spectra of noisy BCABE states
